name: Tachibana Sayaka
source:
[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pastry_chef]Pâtissière[/url] of the antique coffee shop "Curio", Sayaka is clumsy and often makes mistakes. Despite her failures, she is doing her best to practice making sweets. Sayaka is sometimes seen heavily blushing, especially when she gets very nervous. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%82%B7%E3%83%A7%E3%82%B3%E3%83%A9_%E3%80%9Cmaid_cafe_%22curio%22%E3%80%9C]Wikipedia[/url].]
